source.custom: Backgrounds: feat only, no ASI (2026-11-06 ruling).

system.description: Your accent, mannerisms, and appearance mark you as an outsider wherever you go. This draws curious glances and can occasionally be a nuisance, but it also earns you the genuine interest of scholars, nobles, and everyday folk alike, all eager to hear about distant lands. You can use this attention to gain access to people and places that would otherwise be out of reach, for yourself and your companions.
